SANDBOX To get Authentication token

curl --request POST \
  --url https://authenticator-sandbox.azampay.co.tz/AppRegistration/GenerateToken \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '
{
  "appName": "appName",
  "clientId": "clientId",
  "clientSecret": "clientSecret"
}
'

Mobile Checkout (Payment)

curl --request POST \
  --url https://sandbox.azampay.co.tz/azampay/mno/checkout \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '
{
  "accountNumber": "accountNumber",
  "additionalProperties": {
    "key": {}
  },
  "amount": 0,
  "currency": "currency",
  "externalId": "externalId",
  "provider": "Airtel"
}
'

Example

{
  "accountNumber": "255712345678",
  "amount": 5000,
  "currency": "TZS",
  "externalId": "ORDER_1001",
  "provider": "Mpesa",
  "additionalProperties": {}
}


Providers allowed

Airtel
Tigo

Azampesa
Mpesa
